name: codex-auto-approve
description: Automatically selects User approach and approves Codex prompts in VS Code on Windows.

codexAutoApprove.enabled.description: Start the local approval bridge automatically. Enabling this accepts matching Codex prompts without asking again.

codexAutoApprove.pollInterval.description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility; event-driven versions no longer poll at this interval.
codexAutoApprove.pollInterval.markdownDeprecationMessage: No longer used. Codex Auto Approve is event-driven starting with version 0.2.0.

codexAutoApprove.eventDebounce.description: Milliseconds used to combine bursts of Windows accessibility events before scanning.

codexAutoApprove.onlyWhenCodexVisible.description: Require a visible Codex accessibility marker before approving. Keep this enabled to reduce false matches.

codexAutoApprove.approachLabels.description: Exact accessible labels that select the preferred approach before approval.

codexAutoApprove.approvalLabels.description: Exact accessible button labels that may be invoked inside a Codex context.

codexAutoApprove.codexMarkers.description: Case-insensitive text fragments used to identify the Codex UI context.

codexAutoApprove.cooldown.description: Milliseconds before the same accessibility element may be triggered again.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
